# About The Pantry Mama

...

## Easy Sourdough on Any Schedule

...

Founded in 2019 by Kate Freebairn, The Pantry Mama exists to prove that sourdough should fit your life, not the other way around. Through reliable tutorials, creative discard recipes, and practical strategies, home bakers around the world have learned to bake sourdough on any schedule.

...

The Pantry Mama is for beginner and aspiring sourdough bakers who want to develop their own sourdough rhythm, build confidence with fermentation, and enjoy homemade sourdough bread, no matter what life throws their way.

...

## What We Offer

...

- Easy, beginner friendly instructions for how to make a sourdough starter and how to bake sourdough bread.
- Once you’ve established your sourdough starter, you can use it to bake over 400 sourdough recipes and sourdough discard recipes.
- Over 150 articles to teach you how to master sourdough and fit it into your busy life, including lots of sourdough starter tips.
- New recipes added to the site every single week. Make sure you join my email list so you don’t miss a single one!
- Video tutorials and visual instructions for many of the recipes on the site (with new videos added weekly).

...

You’ll find recipes that range from classic sourdough loaves to creative bakes like sourdough cookies, pizzas and flatbreads, and even sourdough desserts, all designed to be approachable, family-friendly, and delicious. Alongside the recipes, I share practical tips, time-saving tricks, and sourdough basics to help you bake confidently, no matter how packed your day is.

...

- Join over 130,000 sourdough bakers who receive recipes delivered right to their inbox, as well as weekly sourdough tips and tutorials – sign up here.
- Join over 360,000 people in my free sourdough community.

Account Not Found on TikTok: What It Means and How to Fix It

...

# How to Fix Account Not Found on TikTok: Causes, Tips & More

...

Why you’re seeing “Account Not Found” on TikTok

...

Did you search for a profile on TikTok and see the "Account Not Found" error? While "Account Not Found" may mean the other person blocked you, there are a few other reasons you might see this message. Here's what it means when you see the Account Not Found TikTok error, what to do, and how to fix it.

...

## What Does Account Not Found Mean?

...

If someone blocks you on TikTok, you'll see "Account Not Found" when you search for their profile. You may also see "Account Not Found" if the person deleted their account or their account was deleted by TikTok. Sometimes problems with the TikTok app or your internet connection can lead to this error.

...

You may have been blocked. TikTok, like many other social media platforms, lets you block people and prevent them from viewing your profile or contacting you. If someone has blocked you and you search for their profile, you'll see "Account Not Found."

...

Advertisement

If the username is no longer in use, you'll see "Account Not Found." The person you're looking for may have deleted their TikTok account or changed their username. If the name you're searching for doesn't match an existing account, you'll see the "Account Not Found" error.

TikTok has a 180-day Inactive Account Policy. To prevent people from creating accounts with the intention of only taking a name, TikTok will reset custom usernames to a generic name after 180 days of inactivity. [1]

If you're searching for a username that hasn't been active in a long time, you'll see "Account Not Found" if the username hasn't been reclaimed.

...

TikTok bans accounts that don't follow the community guidelines. If the account you're looking for posted videos that violated the guidelines and continued uploading similar content after being warned, their account may have been banned from the platform.

...

If you're sure the user exists and you're not blocked, something could be wrong with TikTok.

...

To know if you've been blocked, try searching for the same username using a different TikTok account (or asking a friend to check). If the person's profile shows up from another account, you'll know you are blocked.[2]

...

Why am I seeing "Account Not Found" on TikTok? If you see Account Not Found, this means you're unable to see the current TikTok account.

...

What does "Account Not Found" mean on TikTok? Account Not Found on TikTok means you may be blocked by the user, the user may have deleted their account, or even internet issues.

...

Can I restore a deleted account on TikTok? If you deleted your TikTok account, it is deleted permanently. You can only restore a deactivated account by logging back into your account.[3]

# About

...

Welcome to The Tasteful Pantry, where I explore and learn about all things food. Known to family and friends as Elby, I am the face, ‘head chef’, creator, designer and photographer behind The Tasteful Pantry. More importantly, my three children and husband are the inspiration. I am delighted you are checking out my website and am confident you will enjoy many of my delicious recipes.

...

Throughout my hospitality and culinary journey, I have discovered my passion lies with sharing my homecooked meals. Preparing meals for family and friends and, of course, now sharing the recipes that we all love. So, here you are, getting to know a bit more about the culinary adventure that is my life.
